intro: Silv keeps your space sleek, modern, and organised. A tinted glass top adds elegance, while hidden storage keeps everything from remotes to magazines within reach—without cluttering your space.

features.title: Glass top adds modern, easy-to-clean style
features.text: Upgrade your space instantly—our brown-tinted toughened glass top adds a sophisticated touch while withstanding daily use.

features.title: Stay organised with dual-drawer storage
features.text: Stay clutter-free with storage accessible from both sides—practical living just got that much easier.

features.title: Seamless shelves for neat storage
features.text: Our lower shelf provides a practical, easy-access home for books, devices, or décor, adding both function and personality to your bedside setup.

features.title: Warm walnut finish brings cozy vibes
features.text: Rich walnut tones give our furniture timeless warmth, blending beautifully with modern and traditional décor alike.

features.title: Fits close to walls for flexible setups
features.text: Why waste valuable floor space? Our clever design hugs walls and fits into corners, turning overlooked areas into practical, stylish storage solutions.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
